text:
Anya R: Quick sync — proposal for a tiny post-launch experiment: give 200 starter credits + a 3-step prompt template pack + an invite to a 20-min 'get rolling' office hours. Goal: increase first-7-day active feature usage by 12%.
Liam T: Nice. What's the funnel we’ll measure? activation, second request, retention?
Anya R: activation (first generation), 2nd gen within 48h, and webinar attendance as a proxy for stickiness. Primary metric = % with >=2 generations in 7d.
Sophia M: I can draft 3 short email variants. Variant A: friendly walkthrough; B: prompt-playbook lead; C: direct calendar link + CTA. Short copy, 2 lines.
Rav K: Ops question — can we route the credits via the existing new-signup cohort? Need to avoid overlapping other credit experiments. Also TTL for credits?
Anya R: Route = new_signups_last_14d who haven't used generation API. TTL = 14 days. Only one experiment group at a time.
Liam T: Can you add the exclusion list? expt_id != 'spring-credit-surge' + email opt-outs. Also want to log: cohort_id, variant, credits_granted, first_gen_ts.
GrowthBot: experiment.created id=expt_1765_seed_credit, cohort_size=1200, variants=3, start=1765432110
Marco P: Curious about the prompt pack — can we include 6 short starter prompts: 'summarize', 'rewrite', 'idea-gen', 'code-explain', 'email-draft', 'qa-pair'?
Sophia M: Yes. I'll make them snappy and include copy examples. Also thinking a micro-onboarding carousel inside the product (3 slides) interstitial after first gen.
Rav K: Implementation note: frontend route /welcome should show carousel if credits>0 and first_gen==true. Will need a quick flag. I can do the rollout canary to 10% by region.
Liam T: Data will set up the dashboard. Quick ask: include utm=seed-credit-1765 in all links. Also capture source=webinar_invite for attendees.
Anya R: Timeline: copy by EOD, prompts + carousel mock by tomorrow AM, ops rollout and data dashboard by EOD tomorrow, run 7 days and then snapshot.
Marco P: Small control question — include a holdout group (10%) with no credits but webinar invite so we can isolate credits effect?
Anya R: Good call — yes, add 10% holdout. Updated GrowthBot?
GrowthBot: experiment.updated id=expt_1765_seed_credit, holdout=10%, variants=3, started=1765432110
Sophia M: I'll post the email drafts here and paste the prompt pack. emoji :rocket:
Liam T: I'll set up the dashboard and ping when the cohort is live.
Rav K: Rolling out flag in staging now. Will post deploy link and canary logs.
Anya R: Thanks all — will run retrospective next week. If anyone sees overlap with other promos, ping me immediately. :thumbsup:
